obligations.name: robert_workspace_channels
obligations.description: Conversations that have a conversation_membership for a user literally named Robert who also holds a workspace_membership in the requested workspace (T01WORKSPACE); the user's full identity is left underspecified so two disjoint channel sets both qualify.
obligations.scope: channels within the workspace containing a member named Robert

task_spec.text: Determine which channels have a member named Robert who belongs to our workspace, and report those channels.

access_plan: Use users.list (or known-ID lookups) to find users whose display/real name is 'Robert' plus a surname, then users.info to confirm each one's workspace membership in T01WORKSPACE (excluding Robert Diaz, whose sole workspace membership is T02BETAWORKSPACE). For each qualifying Robert, use users.conversations (or conversations.members across the seeded channel list) to enumerate the channels where that user is a conversation member, yielding the two candidate channel sets; Roberta Lin's channel is excluded on a name-value mismatch.
